channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: High mortality persists among formerly homeless in Ottawa after housing
item.description: A study of chronically homeless individuals in Ottawa who moved into supported housing found a high mortality rate of 22%.

item.title: Remote CBT for insomnia eases symptoms during chemotherapy
item.description: A randomized trial supports cognitive-behavioral therapy for cancer-related insomnia, according to Medscape Medical News.

item.title: Protein discovery may lead to preeclampsia test and treatments
item.description: Cambridge researchers identified a key protein that could predict preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction, major causes of maternal and infant complications.

item.title: Hormone therapy may alleviate menopause-related cognitive issues
item.description: A study suggests hormone treatment could help with memory lapses and concentration problems often reported during menopause.
